$comment: Big 5 Matrix — PRODUCT pricing table (HDV Foundation). Metering is by ACTIVE-parameter-seconds: idle personas draw ~zero compute (see nodes/parameters.ts), so you only pay for the parameters you actually light up, for as long as they run. One conceptual persona = 7,000,000,000 (7B) active parameters. cost = pricePerRequest + (activeParams x durationSec / 1,000,000) x rate. Rates below are USD per MILLION active-parameter-seconds. hardCapUsd null = unlimited (soft cap). This file is loaded by billing/pricing.ts and is safe to edit; no code change required.

FREE.tagline: Kick the tires. Fully metered, hard-capped, zero commitment.

STARTER.tagline: For builders shipping their first agents — predictable per-second economics.

PRO.tagline: Scale personas across the matrix with volume rates and generous soft caps.

ENTERPRISE.tagline: Best-in-class rates, uncapped burst, priority routing, and audit-grade metering.

BYOK.tagline: Route through your own provider. $0 platform fee — you pay only your provider.
